description: Figure 4 is a vertical bar chart titled “Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment” that illustrates the runtime (in seconds) for an ensemble approach (“Our Joint Framework”) and several LLM models on the SEconvo dataset. The horizontal axis contains the model categories, labeled (left to right) “Our Joint Framework,” “ChatGPT,” “DeepSeek,” “LLAMA,” and “Claude,” with the labels angled; the vertical axis is labeled “Runtime (seconds)” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400 with regularly spaced tick marks at 50-second intervals. A legend in the upper-left indicates two color encodings: a dark green bar for “Our Joint Framework” and light blue bars for “LLM Models.” There are five single bars (no grouping or stacking): “Our Joint Framework” is dark green with a value label of 77; “ChatGPT” is light blue labeled 190; “DeepSeek” is light blue labeled 365; “LLAMA” is light blue labeled 172; and “Claude” is light blue labeled 243. Each bar has a black outline and a numeric value printed above it, and the categories appear in the stated left-to-right order without an explicit sorting cue beyond that ordering.
